what: Weekly price ranges of Ukraine's USD sovereign Eurobonds (cents per dollar of face value) as stated in the text of ICU Weekly Insight, 7 Mar 2022 to 25 Mar 2024, and ICU's own price-to-yield statements used to calibrate the price-to-yield conversion. The low end of each range is the cheapest bond, which ICU's statements show to be the longest one. Extracted by research/2026-10/raw/loan_rates (round 12) from the PDFs at the urls; sha256 is of the PDF as downloaded on 2026-10-19.
source: ICU (Investment Capital Ukraine), Weekly Insight, https://icu.ua/en/research/weekly-insight
